questions.stem: A vessel contains milk and water in the ratio \(3:2\). If \(20\) litres of water is added, the ratio changes to \(2:3\). What was the initial quantity of water?
The ratio of milk to water in a container is \(7:3\). If \(10\) litres of water is added, the ratio becomes \(7:5\). Find the initial quantity of milk.

A mixture contains alcohol and water in the ratio \(5:3\). If \(16\) litres of the mixture is replaced with pure alcohol, and the final ratio becomes \(3:1\), what was the initial amount of mixture (in litres)?
questions.keySolution: Let total = \(x\), alcohol = \(5x/8\), water = \(3x/8\). After replacement, only water is reduced. \(\frac{5x/8 + 16*(5/8)}{3x/8 - 16*(3/8)} = 3/1\). Solving gives \(x=48\).

questions.stem: If \(15\) litres of water is added to \(60\) litres of a mixture of milk and water (milk : water = \(4:1\)), what will be the new ratio of milk to water?
questions.keySolution: Milk = \(48\), Water = \(12\). Water after adding = \(27\). Ratio = \(48:27 = 16:9\).

questions.stem: In what ratio should water be added to a solution containing milk and water in ratio \(7:5\) to make the new ratio \(7:8\)?
questions.keySolution: Let milk = \(7x\), water = \(5x\), add \(y\) litres water: \(\frac{7x}{5x+y} = \frac{7}{8}\). \(56x = 35x + 7y\), \(y:x = 3:5\).

questions.stem: To a solution of \(40\) litres of milk and water in the ratio \(3:1\), \(8\) litres of milk is added. Find the new ratio.
questions.keySolution: Original milk = \(30\), water = \(10\), after addition, milk = \(38\), water = \(10\). Ratio = \(38:10 = 19:5\).
